about: A tag on a client entity whose animation blueprint is run every frame. Without it the entity's local pose, world pose and skinning matrices are no longer rewritten and the figure stands as it was; given back, the animation resumes.

evidence.says: Script Extender declares ls::AnimationUpdateComponent::Dummy at +0x0 (BG3Extender/GameDefinitions/Components/Visual.h:165): its author's name and type; the offset is computed from the declared types. Not checked against the game's code.
after RemoveComponent a rotation written into the live local pose is found unchanged on 58 of 59 ticks (0 of 113 with the component), and written skinning matrices are the same bytes seconds later

questions.ask: Which system reads the tag, and why a figure left without it for minutes after a death animation does not move again when it is given back.

survey.from: Script Extender's declarations (BG3Extender/GameDefinitions/Components/Visual.h:165, kind tag), by gatekit symbols se-layouts on 2026-11-14
survey.names: Every name here is Script Extender's author's (his headers), not the game's own: they are kept because they are what the extender's Lua answers to and what bg3_verify compares, and every field carries the rung `extender` - the extender's name for the field at that offset, which nobody has checked against the game's code. A name is raised from `extender` only with evidence from the code, by `gatekit names set`.
